scenicChapters.title: Lavaux Vineyard Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Lavaux Vineyard Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-stations-de-morges-bahnhof.story: From Morges it runs 310 km to Morges; allow about 5 h 21 of riding. The stops in between: The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier, Baie de Clendy, Les Grèves and Bahnhof. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
